title: Hybrid Entra join is still used for Autopilot

messages.businessImpact: Provisioning depends on line of sight to a domain controller, so a new starter working from home cannot be provisioned without a VPN, and the process carries failure modes that cloud join does not have.
remediation: Plan a move to Entra join for new devices, keeping hybrid only for applications that genuinely require domain authentication.
Treat this as a project rather than a setting change.
messages.cannotSee: Hybrid join may be deliberate, since an estate with on-premises resources that need a domain-joined machine has a reason for it. What this cannot see is whether those dependencies still exist, which is the question worth asking rather than the setting itself.
